question: The calculated formula unit mass of {Na}₂{SO}₄ is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**142 u**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The formula unit mass of a compound is calculated by summing up the atomic masses of all the atoms present in its chemical formula.
 
• The chemical formula of sodium sulfate is **Na₂SO₄**, which consists of:
 
 
• **2 sodium (Na) atoms**, each with an atomic mass of **23 u**.
 
• **1 sulfur (S) atom**, with an atomic mass of **32 u**.
 
• **4 oxygen (O) atoms**, each with an atomic mass of **16 u**.
 
 
 
• Calculation of formula unit mass:
 
 
• Mass of sodium: **2 × 23 = 46 u**
 
• Mass of sulfur: **1 × 32 = 32 u**
